abstract: Twenty-five consecutive patients referred to the Department of Gynecology and Obstetrics, Karolinska Hospital, Stockholm, because of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) had colour flow Doppler performed. The examinations were performed transabdominally in the initial ten patients and transvaginally thereafter. Tumour vessels within the uterus were detected in eighteen patients (72%). A negative colour Doppler finding in patients with persistent disease could imply a diagnosis of choriocarcinoma rather than invasive mole, but all five patients belonging to this group responded promptly to chemotherapy. There seems to be a rough correlation between extent of uterine disease, as judged by colour flow Doppler, and response to chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: カロリンスカ病院産婦人科を受診した妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTN)の連続25例にカラーフロードプラ検査を実施した。最初の10例は経腹的に、その後は経膣的に検査を行った。子宮内に腫瘍血管が18例(72%)で検出された。持続病変を有する患者でドプラ所見が陰性の場合は、侵入奇胎ではなく絨毛癌が考えられたが、このグループの5例はすべて化学療法に速やかに反応した。カラードプラで評価した子宮病変の範囲と化学療法への反応性との間には、おおまかな相関があるように思われる。
